question:
Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.

Irritate
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Irritate"** means to annoy or make someone slightly angry. (चिढ़ाना)

 
 
• **Example: **His constant humming** irritated **everyone in the office.
 
 
 
• **"Pacify" **refers to calming someone down or bringing peace to a situation. (शांत करना)
 
 
• **Example: **The mother tried to **pacify** her crying baby by rocking her gently.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'irritate' **is **'pacify'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Miff **(नाराज करना): To annoy or offend someone slightly.

 
 
• **Example:** She was miffed by his casual remarks about her work.
 
 
 
• **Pester **(परेशान करना): To annoy someone with frequent requests or interruptions.
 
 
• **Example: **The kids kept pestering their mother for sweets.
 
 
 
• **Annoy** (चिढ़ाना): To make someone a little angry; similar in meaning to irritate.
 
 
• **Example:** The loud music from the party annoyed the neighbors.
 
 

3c:Tc31,

The correct answer is: **Option 1.**
